# User — Roles
{: .no_toc }

Assign and remove roles for a user.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ROL-04` |
| **Route** | `/admin/users/:userId/roles` · deep link `substratal://admin/users/:userId/roles` |
| **Where** | Administration › Users |
| **Who can use it** | users.list (read), roles.manage (write) |
| **Kind** | tab |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwViewStack` page |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rows | list | UserRoleAssignment: role, application_id, assigned_at, assigned_by, implicit | implicit → "Granted with app access", not removable | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Assign role | button → role picker |  |  | AdwDialog with GtkSearchEntry list |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Assign | `POST /users/{id}/roles/{roleId}` | idempotent; 200 already held |
| Remove | `DELETE /users/{id}/roles/{roleId}` | 409 → implicit role |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/{id}/roles`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
